channel.title: BMD Installer Updates
channel.description: Most recent updates to BMD Installer.

item.title: Version 1.2
item.description:
What's New in 1.2

  • Hide software — hide products you don't use from the Home grid, with a "Hidden" button beside the search bar to review and unhide them (hiding a product also removes it from favourites)
  • Copy Download Link — copy the direct download link for any specific version from a product's version list
  • Reveal in Finder and Uninstall added to the product card right-click menu; the uninstaller launches Blackmagic Design's own uninstaller
  • Automatically refreshes installed versions after an uninstall completes
  • Fixed products still showing as installed after being uninstalled — installed status is now verified against the app on disk, not just the package receipt
  • Cleaned up malformed installed version strings (e.g. Fairlight Live)

item.title: Version 1.1.4
item.description:
What's New in 1.1.4

  • Settings page — Open on Login, Allow Notifications, and Light/Dark/System appearance toggle
  • Beta version detection — beta releases shown separately with purple badge
  • Fairlight Live added with version detection and manual download link
  • Fixed Blackmagic RAW and other products showing as "unknown" when API entries lack the beta field
  • Registration form now collects all required Blackmagic Design fields (phone, address, city, state, zip)
  • Removed Knowledge Base tab

item.title: Version 1.1.3
item.description:
What's New in 1.1.3

  • Search bar in Home view — filter products by name instantly
